resource: Direct Container(parent = corpse) entries of one creature's corpse ItemInstance
allocation_impact: The composing caller checks the full accepted loot plan before freezing any mint. At commit, the database locks the corpse receipt before counting and admits at most 30 direct entries, including concurrent writers. Generated loot-plan limits remain separate.
boundary_tests: max=30: the 30th loot entry is placed in the corpse container
max+1=31: the 31st loot entry is refused by the database, leaving exactly 30 live entries
notes: SUMMER owner decision 20 (2026-10-26) supersedes D131 capacity 16. Container capacity is 30; the independent COMBAT01-LOOT-PLAN-ITEMS and COMBAT01-ITEMS-PER-CORPSE limits remain 16 for generated plans. Actual Item capacity and lifecycle still require content admission.
